metadata.mspc:about: MASTER-INFERENCE.svg — the rust chain IS the api. Pair file: studio/docs/Tesseract.svg (sister Claude's 253-node MySpace++ manifest). This file is HOW it runs (chain loop, layer targeting, visitor surface). That file is WHAT exists (nodes, subsystems, project types). Together they form one master inference orchestrator. Consolidation proposal: /data/Projects/MySpace++/CONSOLIDATION.md

g.text: ⌬ MASTER-INFERENCE.svg — the rust chain IS the api
one droplet · one chain database · one stacked HTMX SVG view · visitor-aware rendering · zero ads · zero logins · zero phishing
pair file: studio/docs/Tesseract.svg (253 MySpace++ nodes · 8 DAGs · walker contract). this file: HOW the chain runs.
Layer 0 — the request lifecycle (browser visit IS the chain trigger)
this loop IS the http handler
run inference ONLY on layer L
skip layers irrelevant to this visit
all surfaces = same SVG, diff layers shown
SVG carries inline JS / CSS / WebGL
visitor budget = how much they can see
— browser IS now the runtime extension
cache keyed by visitor + path + chain hash
next visit hits cache or extends chain
what you can REACH in chain = what you see
— no per-page ACL; chain reachability IS ACL
Layer 1 — the rust chain loop (rotating inference)
picks next op based on activation_hex
seals output bytes into a hash
until fixed point OR visitor budget hit
→ this fn IS your API server
layer rotation — which TinyTransformer layers fire per visit
visitor A: layers [0,3,7,11] fire · visitor B: [1,4,8] · admin: [all]
— layers ignored cost ZERO (Suboxone-style binding affinity)
Layer 2 — one stacked HTMX SVG view (ALL surfaces)
no login wall · just show it
access = ability to reach in chain
all surfaces ship in ONE SVG; layers toggled via gently:enabled per visitor scope
user clicks → hx-get returns partial SVG → hx-swap=outerHTML replaces ONE <g>
— no client routing, no SPA, no separate landing/tools/admin pages
Layer 3 — chain database = access control (no logins, no phishing)
what you can REACH in chain = what you see
visitor's chain = list of nodes they've extended
no oauth roundtrip · keys are signed bytes
no ads · no phishing · no tracking
no third-party JS on the page
— visit = chain extension; key = chain reach
Layer 4 — visitor-aware rendering (what gets cooked depends on WHO)
— browser cooks juice for the new bits only
Layer 5 — Lucid pattern borrowed (design, not payment)
— same shape spec runs on our droplet
implemented in JS inline in SVG
friend keys: READ only (open URL, see)
— Lucid OAuth scopes, our key store
our droplet · our SVG · our chain
Layer 6 — bridge to sister Tesseract (WHAT exists ⇄ HOW it runs)
— layer rotation (which 12 layers fire per visit)
— one stacked HTMX SVG view (landing / tools / admin / tesseract)
— Lucid design pattern (custom shapes + formulas + scopes + MCP)
authoritative for: scheduling, dispatch, signing, rendering
— walker.py contract (3 reqs: id + neighbors + subjects)
authoritative for: inventory, contract, project state
one chain → both SVGs as data
one identify() that works on both SVGs
fourth req added: which chain seq populated this
unlock: same agents work both SVGs
M2 — rust chain as web handler
each route extends chain · emits SVG fragment
unlock: same chain serves anon / user / admin differently
click any layer → hx-get returns <g> fragment
unlock: landing / tools / admin / tesseract on one page
MASTER-INFERENCE.svg v1.0.0 · rust chain IS the api · one stacked HTMX SVG view · zero ads zero logins zero phishing
